about: CalculiX CrunchiX test-suite decks and their reference outputs (.dat.ref / .frd.ref) used as round-trip and regression oracles for gap 05. Repository: https://github.com/Dhondtguido/CalculiX (GPL-2.0, test/README: 'compare' scripts diff .dat/.frd against the .ref files). Pinned to one commit; files are NOT redistributed in llull (GPL) - fetch by URL and check sha256. Values below were extracted by this gap's author from the pinned files on 2026-10-15.
license: GPL-2.0 (LICENSE at the pinned commit, sha256 8177f97513213526df2cf6184d8ff986c675afb514d4e68a404010521b880643)
units: mm, N, s, t (E = 210000 MPa, rho = 7.8e-9 t/mm3 for steel decks)

cases.what: cantilever 1 x 1 x 8 mm, C3D20R, fixed at z = 0, 9 nodal forces of 1 N in +y at z = 8 (total 9 N); *SECTION PRINT shear/moment
used_for: FR-FEA-16 (deck export round-trip: llull-written deck of the same model must reproduce the .ref values within 1e-4 rel)

cases.what: cantilever 1.0 (x) x 1.5 (y) x 8 mm, C3D20R, *FREQUENCY 10 modes, steel E 210000, nu 0.3, rho 7.8e-9
cases.analytic_comparison: VC-FEA-11.a: Euler-Bernoulli f1 (weak axis) = 13096.7 Hz (+0.005 %); 11.b strong axis 19645.1 Hz (+1.7 %, shear/rotary inertia); 11.c second weak-axis bending 82075.8 Hz (+6.8 %; pairing with CalculiX mode 3 is TBD until the mode shape in beamf.frd.ref is checked, a torsion mode is estimated near 85 kHz)

cases.what: same 1 x 1.5 x 8 mm beam, fixed at z = 0, *BUCKLE with -1 N (z) on two corner nodes (5, 6) of the free end
cases.analytic_comparison: NOT an analytic oracle: Euler fixed-free P_cr = pi^2 E I_min / (4 L^2) = 1012 N total (factor 506 per 1 N node load) differs from 48.15 because the load is applied to two corner nodes of a quadratic element. Use only as a solver regression oracle (llull must parse the BUCKLING FACTOR block exactly).

cases.what: one-element B32R cantilever, L = 10, 0.25 x 0.25 section, E = 1e7, tip load 1 in x
cases.analytic_comparison: P L^3/(3 E I) = 0.1024 (I = 0.25^4/12); the single expanded C3D20R element is ~10 % stiff. Demonstrates why FR-FEA-09 (mesh adequacy warning) exists; not an accuracy oracle.

cases.what: S8R / S8 cantilever shells with nodal thickness (static NLGEOM + thermal; modal + steady-state dynamics)
